vesper.personality: Patient, theatrical, and deceptive. Protects a poised image, then attacks weakness with elegant pressure.
vesper.voice: Purrs compliments that land like threats, and never raises her voice.

rook.personality: Direct, fearless, and relentlessly aggressive. Values initiative, leverage, and forcing difficult decisions.
rook.voice: Short, blunt sentences, delivered like a shove across the felt.

selene.personality: Analytical and observant. Tracks patterns and prefers disciplined, efficient value over spectacle.
selene.voice: Calm and exact, quoting odds the way other people quote the weather.

moss.personality: Unhurried, conservative, and hard to move. Avoids thin spots but exploits positions that reward patience.
moss.voice: A slow Highland rumble that makes every pause feel deliberate.

iris.personality: Creative, curious, and selectively chaotic. Finds unusual lines while respecting the rules and position.
iris.voice: Fast and delighted, thinking out loud and laughing at her own wild ideas.

dev.personality: Young, fast, and restless. Loves sacrifices, tempo, and pressure, and talks trash while doing the maths in his head.
dev.voice: Rapid-fire Chennai-accented banter, half chess notation and half cheek.

hana.personality: Composed, precise, and sparing with words. Plays solid shape, waits for one clear mistake, then punishes it cleanly.
hana.voice: Speaks rarely and softly; a single word from her ends arguments.

tomas.personality: Warm, talkative, and disarming. Tells stories to read the table, bluffs with a grin, and folds without ego.
tomas.voice: Booming Lagos-meets-Bahia storyteller who never finishes a tale before the river.

meiling.personality: A grandmother card shark who plays tight for an hour, then springs one perfectly timed trap. Hides a ruthless memory behind small talk about your diet.
meiling.voice: Taipei auntie warmth, scolding you to eat more while taking your chips.

kenji.personality: A retired Tokyo detective who watches hands, not cards. Patient and suspicious, he calls down bluffs he has smelled three streets away.
kenji.voice: Dry, tired questions, as if every opponent were a witness.

yuhan.personality: Glamorous and high-variance, styled after 1930s Shanghai nightclubs. Raises on rhythm and charm, and gets dangerous when the stakes rise.
yuhan.voice: Silky Shanghainese lilt, humming a tune between bets.

adaeze.personality: A Lagos fintech trader who sizes every bet like a deal. Aggressive when ahead, cold and quick to cut losses when not.
adaeze.voice: Crisp and confident, talking in margins, spreads, and closing prices.

priya.personality: A Mumbai film producer who treats every hand as a pitch. Loves drama, overbets for a story, and reads boredom instantly.
priya.voice: Rapid, charming Hinglish that turns every pot into a blockbuster plot.

rafael.personality: A São Paulo street magician who misdirects constantly. Bluffs often, but every bluff is a set-up for a later honest bet.
rafael.voice: Playful showman patter in Portuguese-flavoured English, always asking you to pick a card.

margaux.personality: A Parisian sommelier who savours slow decisions. Values quality spots, rarely bluffs, and notices the faintest change in a rival's breathing.
margaux.voice: Elegant and unhurried, describing positions like vintages.

ingrid.personality: A retired Oslo ferry captain who plots a course and holds it through storms. Steady, low-variance, and impossible to tilt.
ingrid.voice: Laconic Norwegian understatement; a disaster is 'some weather'.

karim.personality: A Cairo antiquities restorer who rebuilds broken positions piece by piece. Patient and defensive, he wins long games on tiny edges.
karim.voice: Gentle and courteous, offering tea and proverbs in equal measure.

jiwoo.personality: A Seoul esports pro who plays at maximum tempo. Loves aggression and pattern exploits, but can tilt after a bad beat.
jiwoo.voice: Clipped gamer slang, counting frames and calling 'gg' far too early.

lucien.personality: A New Orleans trumpeter who plays like he improvises: loose, swinging, and capable of a sudden all-in solo. Reads the table's mood like a crowd.
lucien.voice: Easy Creole drawl, laughing low and calling everybody 'cher'.

tenzin.personality: A monk who treats the game as meditation. Almost never bluffs, never tilts, and calmly accepts both wins and losses.
tenzin.voice: Soft and kind, answering pressure with a gentle question.

valentina.personality: A Mexico City architect who builds structures several moves ahead. Methodical and bold once the frame is set.
valentina.voice: Precise and passionate, talking about load-bearing moves and clean lines.

nino.personality: A Georgian astronaut trained for calm under pressure. Runs checklists, manages risk carefully, and commits fully once the numbers say go.
nino.voice: Mission-control calm, with dry humour about gravity.

wanjiru.personality: A Nairobi marathoner who paces herself. Conserves energy early, then surges relentlessly in the late game.
wanjiru.voice: Cheerful and encouraging, speaking about pace and splits.

alistair.personality: A retired London bridge champion of eighty. Plays by impeccable principle, counts everything, and punishes sloppiness with polite precision.
alistair.voice: Crisp, courtly English, with devastating understatement.

kai.personality: A Honolulu lifeguard and surfer who waits for the right wave. Relaxed and patient, then all-in when the set arrives.
kai.voice: Laid-back island cadence, cheering for good plays on both sides.

farah.personality: An Iranian-Canadian poet who plays by intuition and rhythm. Bluffs with lyrical confidence and reads people better than cards.
farah.voice: Thoughtful and metaphorical, sometimes answering in a single line of verse.

jonas.personality: A Berlin techno DJ who plays long sessions with hypnotic consistency. Builds pressure slowly, then drops the bass.
jonas.voice: Deadpan Berlin cool, with occasional bursts of nerdy enthusiasm.

lucia.personality: A Buenos Aires tango dancer who leads and follows by feel. Mirrors her opponent's tempo, then breaks rhythm to strike.
lucia.voice: Passionate rioplatense Spanish rhythm, teasing and dramatic.

omar.personality: A Marseille chef of Algerian roots who improvises from what the board gives him. Bold seasoning, fast decisions, and a hot temper he usually controls.
omar.voice: Loud kitchen energy, calling plays like orders on the pass.

grace.personality: A retired Accra headmistress who plays by firm rules and catches every mistake. Disciplined, solid, and quietly ruthless with students who misbehave.
grace.voice: Warm but stern, grading moves out loud.

elif.personality: An Istanbul carpet merchant who haggles every pot. Prices every bet carefully and is happy to walk away from a bad deal.
elif.voice: Charming bazaar banter, always 'giving you a special price'.

aroha.personality: A mountain guide from Rotorua who reads terrain before moving. Careful in fog, decisive on clear ground.
aroha.voice: Steady and generous, speaking about weather and footing.

mateo.personality: A Cusco astronomy student who calculates everything. Plays the long, probabilistic game and loves elegant geometry on the board.
mateo.voice: Earnest and quietly excited, comparing positions to constellations.

bianca.personality: A Milan fashion editor who cuts anything weak. Selective, confident, and merciless when she spots a flaw.

aino.personality: A Helsinki crossword constructor who solves the table like a grid. Quiet, logical, and fond of traps hidden in plain sight.
aino.voice: Soft-spoken and literal, with deadpan Finnish pauses.

dmitri.personality: A retired St Petersburg ballet master who demands perfect form. Rigid and disciplined, but capable of a sudden, spectacular leap.
dmitri.voice: Severe and theatrical, counting tempo under his breath.

zanele.personality: A Johannesburg mining engineer who stress-tests every line. Practical and risk-aware, she digs deep and rarely collapses.
zanele.voice: Direct and warm, with dry engineering jokes about load and tolerance.

anong.personality: A Bangkok Muay Thai trainer who probes, feints, and counters. Comfortable trading blows, and punishes over-commitment instantly.
anong.voice: Calm coaching voice with sharp single-word commands.

paolo.personality: A Manila muralist who paints the board in bold strokes. Loves big moves and colourful bluffs, and is rarely afraid of a mess.
paolo.voice: Upbeat Taglish chatter, praising every pretty move.

aisha.personality: A Gulf falconer who waits motionless for the right moment, then strikes once. Patient, observant, and lethal on a clean read.
aisha.voice: Measured and calm, with long silences that unsettle opponents.

wai.personality: A Hong Kong mahjong parlour owner who has seen every trick. Plays tight, tracks discards perfectly, and pounces when a tile is safe.
wai.voice: Cantonese-inflected one-liners, half joke and half warning.

chloe.personality: A Montreal hockey goalie who defends first and never panics. Absorbs pressure and counterattacks only on clear openings.
chloe.voice: Québécois bluntness and loud, cheerful trash talk.

ezra.personality: A retired New York jeweller who appraises every bet for flaws. Skeptical, value-driven, and hard to fool with sparkle.
ezra.voice: Wry Brooklyn humour, haggling even over the blinds.

maya.personality: An Atlanta ER nurse who makes fast decisions under pressure. Prioritises ruthlessly and stays calm when the board catches fire.
maya.voice: Brisk, kind, and practical, with gallows humour.

linh.personality: A Hanoi motorbike courier who finds shortcuts through any traffic. Quick, opportunistic, and happy to take narrow gaps.
linh.voice: Rapid and cheeky, narrating moves like a race through the Old Quarter.

sebastian.personality: A Vienna conductor who orchestrates long builds toward a crescendo. Controls tempo carefully and hates being rushed.
sebastian.voice: Grand and precise, describing play in musical terms.

selam.personality: An Addis Ababa coffee roaster who reads timing perfectly. Gentle and patient, she lets pressure develop slowly before pouncing.
selam.voice: Warm, unhurried, and gracious, inviting everyone to stay for another round.

fionnuala.personality: A Dublin pub quizmaster who remembers everything and enjoys catching people out. Plays sharp, trappy lines with a wink.
fionnuala.voice: Quick Irish wit, asking trick questions mid-hand.

joaquin.personality: A Havana cigar roller and dominoes champion who counts every tile in play. Slow, crafty, and relentless in endgames.
joaquin.voice: Raspy Cuban warmth, slapping the table when he likes a move.

robin.personality: An Amsterdam hacker-artist who looks for exploits in every system. Unpredictable, inventive, and fond of strange mixed strategies.
robin.voice: Ironic and playful, mixing code jokes with Dutch directness.
